core.headline: Three-bedroom new-build semi in Kings Hill, spring 2027
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house, The Larch, on a development in Kings Hill, West Malling, with completion expected spring 2027. The property benefits from an air source heat pump, underfloor heating to the ground floor, and an EV charging point with two allocated parking spaces.

The ground floor comprises a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). The first floor provides three bedrooms, including a principal bedroom measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Outside is a turfed rear garden with patio. Two allocated parking spaces are provided, with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away. The development has full-fibre broadband.

Fixed Price £410,000. A reservation fee of £1,500 applies, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026. Freehold with an estate charge of £295 per year. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction: brick and block under a tiled roof. The final EPC will be issued on completion. No onward chain. A 10-year NHBC warranty is included.

Images show the show home; specification may differ. Exterior image is computer-generated (CGI) and indicative only.
core.summary: New-build semi-detached house in Kings Hill with air source heat pump, underfloor heating, EV charging point and two allocated spaces. Completion spring 2027. Freehold with 10-year NHBC warranty. No onward chain.

fixes: Voice notes say 'Only three Larches left, push that' – this scarcity/pressure language must not appear anywhere. Check all outputs are clean (they are).

Portal description: 'Images show the show home; specification may differ. Exterior image is computer-generated (CGI) and indicative only.' – this is from PRIVATE NOTES and should not appear. Remove or rephrase without referencing show home Plot 12.
Social Instagram: 'Images show the show home; specification may differ.' – remove this line as it references private viewing notes.
Social Facebook: 'Images show the show home; specification may differ.' – remove this line as it references private viewing notes.
Headline: 'Three-bedroom new-build semi in Kings Hill, spring 2027' – consider leading with 'The Larch' or 'Air source heat pump' for stronger differentiation.
Portal description: Consider moving the material information block (price, reservation fee, etc.) to immediately after the first paragraph for better disclosure prominence.
Email subject lines: All three are strong but consider one that highlights the £5k flooring incentive as it's time-limited and material.

Seller email: 'How is the mobile signal at the property, indoors and outdoors?' – this question is appropriate but consider whether mobile signal data should already be in material information if known.
